MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.

Shanghai, August 5, 1926.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
-2-

The Shanghai College of Law, Frenchtown, has been in existence about four years. It was founded by George Hsu Chien (徐謙), ex-Minister of Justice, and his wife Sung Nyi Ping (沈儀彬), (sister of Sung Pao Chang(沈寶昌), formerly Shanghai City Magistrate) who are both at present in Russia. The school depends for its upkeep on a subsidy received from Feng Yu Ziang(馮玉祥) who is a close friend of George Hsu Chien (徐謙), subscriptions from prominent Kuomintangs, and fees paid by pupils. It has altogether about five hundred students, amongst whom are natives of all parts of China. The school specializes in teaching Civil and Criminal Law, Economics, Sociology, French, Russian, Japanese, and Chinese. The students have organized several societies among themselves, and a number are members of the Shanghai Students' Union. The following is a list of the most important members of the faculty of the school:-

| Sung Nyi Ping(沈儀彬), Wife of George Hsu Chien. | Secretary. | She is at present with her husband in Russia. |

| Chu Yi Yuan, (朱巽元) a native of Shanghai & graduate of St. John's University. | Professor of Logic. | No. 13 Tien Ziang (天祥里)Li, Rue Amiral Bayle, French Town. |
| Yang Ka Ping(楊家慶), a native of Shanghai, and graduate of St. John's University. | Professor of Mathematics. | No. 178S Yangtszepoo Road. |

The Shanghai College of Law up to the end of the last school term, occupied No. 479 Rue Auguste Boppe and No. 59 Rue de Siemens, but will remove to a new building on Rue Pere Robert after the Summer holidays.
